kaikki_vikisozluk.e: أَرْهَفَ • (ʔarhafa) IV (non-past يُرْهِفُ (yurhifu), verbal noun إِرْهَاف (ʔirhāf))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Causative of رَهُفَ (rahufa, “to be thin, slim or slender; to be sharp”).
g: to make thin, slim or slender

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Elative of رَهِف (rahif, “thin, slim”) and رَهِيف (rahīf, “thin, slim; sharp”) and مُرْهَف (murhaf, “thin, slim; sharp”).
g: elative degree of رَهِف (rahif) and elative degree of رَهِيف (rahīf) and elative degree of مُرْهَف (murhaf):
thinner, slimmer, slenderer; thinnest, slimmest, slenderest
